boundary_noise.verdict_statement: Even a theoretical perfect predictor of the expected window citations would be wrong on about 52.7% of papers because citation arrivals follow a stochastic Poisson process near tier boundaries. The realistic accuracy ceiling on 2-year data is capped at ~47.3%, confirming that 85% accuracy is mathematically impossible.
